subject: Configure Logfire instrumentation
description:
In `capo/main.py`, call `logfire.configure()` and `logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai()` at boot. Wire FastAPI instrumentation. Make Logfire optional via `observability.logfire_enabled` (per §15.3) — instrument only when enabled.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `logfire.configure()` called once at boot when `observability.logfire_enabled=true`.
- [ ] Pydantic AI is instrumented; agent runs produce traces with `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cost_usd`.
- [ ] FastAPI is instrumented; webhook handler shows up as a span.
- [ ] `LOGFIRE_TOKEN` is read from `.env`; missing token with `logfire_enabled=true` is a clear startup error.
- [ ] When `logfire_enabled=false`, no Logfire calls are made (clean disable, not a no-op wrapper).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Logfire backend unreachable at boot: continue with local logging only; emit a startup warning.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: end-to-end run produces `capo.agent.run` span with token + cost attributes
• Unit: disable path doesn't import Logfire's send pipeline

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 6.5, 9.5, 15.3
